title: OpenWiz vs Devin
description: Compare OpenWiz and Devin on licensing, where agents run, work tracking, pull request review and pricing.
answer: OpenWiz is an open source agent factory that coordinates coding agents and tracks work in GitHub. Devin is Cognition’s coding agent for writing and testing code, with a cloud workflow that can take a Linear ticket through to a pull request.

sections.heading: At a glance
sections.body:
| | OpenWiz | Devin |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Open source and licence | Open source under Apache-2.0. [OpenWiz README](https://github.com/openwizdev/OpenWiz/blob/09ad084f81023de18f2cd3b9f1967d9abb7f5c89/README.md). | Devin is proprietary software offered under Cognition’s terms. [Cognition platform terms](https://cognition.com/legal/platform-terms-of-service), checked 2026-11-28. |
| Where agents run | On your computer or VPS, in a boat.dev sandbox, or in a CloudRoom thread. [OpenWiz 0.1.0 changelog](https://github.com/openwizdev/OpenWiz/blob/09ad084f81023de18f2cd3b9f1967d9abb7f5c89/CHANGELOG.md#010--2026-11-21). | Devin Cloud runs hosted sessions. Devin CLI runs locally. With Outposts, commands and file edits run on your infrastructure, while planning and inference run in Devin Cloud. [Outposts](https://docs.devin.ai/cloud/outposts/overview), checked 2026-11-28. [Local CLI](https://docs.devin.ai/cli), checked 2026-11-28. |
| Which agents | The local driver runs Claude Code or Codex using your existing sign-in. [OpenWiz 0.1.0 changelog](https://github.com/openwizdev/OpenWiz/blob/09ad084f81023de18f2cd3b9f1967d9abb7f5c89/CHANGELOG.md#010--2026-11-21). | Devin Cloud offers a session agent selector with options such as Lite, Normal and Ultra. [Devin session guide](https://docs.devin.ai/get-started/first-run), checked 2026-11-28. |
| How work is tracked | GitHub issues hold specs, tickets and agent status. Pull requests and reviews stay on GitHub. [How OpenWiz works](https://github.com/openwizdev/OpenWiz/blob/09ad084f81023de18f2cd3b9f1967d9abb7f5c89/docs/how-openwiz-works.md). | You can follow progress in the Devin session and hand work over from Linear by assigning a ticket to Devin. [Devin introduction](https://docs.devin.ai/get-started/devin-intro), checked 2026-11-28. [Linear integration](https://docs.devin.ai/integrations/linear), checked 2026-11-28. |
| Review | In 0.1.0 the CloudRoom fleet routes green pull requests to a separate reviewer when available. With local or boat.dev builders, you review pull requests yourself. [How OpenWiz works](https://github.com/openwizdev/OpenWiz/blob/09ad084f81023de18f2cd3b9f1967d9abb7f5c89/docs/how-openwiz-works.md). | Devin Review can analyze GitHub pull requests or GitLab merge requests on demand, and it supports automatic review. [Devin Review](https://docs.devin.ai/work-with-devin/devin-review), checked 2026-11-28. |
| Price | The software is free. You pay your own model and host charges. [OpenWiz README](https://github.com/openwizdev/OpenWiz/blob/09ad084f81023de18f2cd3b9f1967d9abb7f5c89/README.md). | Self-serve plans list Free, Pro at $20/month, Max at $200/month and Teams at $80/month. Enterprise rates are set in the customer agreement. [Self-serve plans](https://docs.devin.ai/admin/billing/self-serve), checked 2026-11-28. [Enterprise billing](https://docs.devin.ai/admin/billing/enterprise), checked 2026-11-28. |

sections.heading: Where Devin fits better
sections.body: Choose Devin if your team already works in Linear and wants to assign a scoped issue to a cloud coding agent that can open a pull request. [Linear integration](https://docs.devin.ai/integrations/linear), checked 2026-11-28.

sections.heading: Where OpenWiz fits better
sections.body: Choose OpenWiz when GitHub is already where you keep specs, tickets and reviews, and you want to run builders on a host you choose. [How OpenWiz works](https://github.com/openwizdev/OpenWiz/blob/09ad084f81023de18f2cd3b9f1967d9abb7f5c89/docs/how-openwiz-works.md).

faq.question: Can Devin run commands on infrastructure I manage?
faq.answer: Yes. Devin Outposts runs commands and edits files on workers you operate. Planning and inference for those sessions stay in Devin Cloud.

faq.question: Does OpenWiz charge for the coding agents or hosts I use?
faq.answer: OpenWiz is free. Your model and host providers bill you separately.

sources.supports: OpenWiz is an open source agent factory under Apache-2.0. The software is free, and users cover their own model and host charges.
GitHub records specs, tickets, pull requests and reviews. In OpenWiz 0.1.0 the CloudRoom fleet can route pull requests to separate reviewers. Local and boat.dev pull requests are reviewed by hand.
OpenWiz 0.1.0 offers builders on your computer or VPS, on boat.dev, or in CloudRoom. The local driver uses Claude Code or Codex with your own sign-in.
Cognition describes Devin as its coding agent that writes, runs and tests code. You can see its progress and tools in the workspace.
You can assign Linear tickets to Devin and turn them into pull requests.
Cognition licenses use of its platform and retains intellectual property rights. The platform terms restrict modification and access to the software components.
Devin Cloud hosts sessions. Outposts shifts command and file operations to user-operated workers while planning and inference stay in Devin Cloud.
Devin CLI is a local terminal coding agent.
Devin Cloud’s session agent selector includes Lite, Normal and Ultra.
Devin Review supports one-off or automatic reviews on GitHub and GitLab.
Cognition lists the Free, Pro, Max and Teams self-serve prices.
Devin Enterprise bills at the rate set in the customer’s order form.

better_fit: Choose Devin if your team already works in Linear and wants to assign a scoped issue to a cloud coding agent that can open a pull request.
